content: The AHA 2015 schedule outlines the coordination of TV events for the conference. Open time slots are marked in red. Below are the details of scheduled interviews and topics: Sunday, November 8, 2015 11:00 AM: Dr. Karen Alexander will discuss Angina and Quality of Life Following PCI with Incomplete Revascularization: Results from the RIVER-PCI Trial. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 11:45 AM. 12:00 PM: Dr. Mihai Gheorghiade will present on Oral sGC Stimulator Vericiguat in Patients with Worsening Chronic Heart Failure and Reduced Ejection Fraction: The SOCRATES-REDUCED Study. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 8, 2015, at 4:13 PM. 1:00 PM: Dr. Henning Bundgaard will discuss The First-in-Man Randomized Trial of a β3-Adrenoceptor Agonist in Chronic Heart Failure: The BEAT-HF Trial. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 11, 2015, at 10:57 AM. 1:30 PM: Dr. Margaret Redfield will present Nitrate's Effect on Activity Tolerance in Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (NEAT-HFpEF). The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 8, 2015, at 4:04 PM. 2:00 PM: Dr. Michael Ong will discuss Remote Patient Management After Discharge of Hospitalized Heart Failure Patients: The BETTER-HF Study. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 8, 2015, at 4:22 PM. 2:30 PM: Dr. Bonnie Spring will present A Clinical Trial of a Mobile Health Intervention for Simultaneous vs. Sequential Diet and Activity Change. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 9, 2015, at 11:13 AM. 3:00 PM: Dr. Iftikhar Kullo will discuss The Effect of Disclosing Genomic Risk of Coronary Heart Disease on LDL Cholesterol Levels: The MI-GENES Study. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 9, 2015, at 11:22 AM. Monday, November 9, 2015 9:00 AM: Dr. Noel Bairey-Merz will present A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial of Late Na Channel Inhibition (Ranolazine) in Coronary Microvascular Dysfunction (CMD): Impact on Angina and Myocardial Ischemia. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 11, 2015, at 11:45 AM. 10:00 AM: Dr. Robert Yeh will discuss Individualizing Treatment Duration of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy After PCI: An Analysis of the DAPT Study. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 11:30 AM. 10:30 AM: Dr. Myeong-Ki Hong will present Clinical Outcomes of Intravascular Ultrasound-Guided Everolimus-Eluting Stents Implantation in Long Coronary Lesions. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 11:00 AM. 11:30 AM: Drs. Geeta Gulati, Siri Heck, and Torbjørn Omland will discuss Prevention of Cardiac Dysfunction During Adjuvant Breast Cancer Therapy (PRADA): Primary Results of a Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 11, 2015, at 11:09 AM. 12:00 PM: Dr. Basil Lewis will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up in Hebrew. 12:30 PM: Dr. Douglas Mann will present One-Year Follow-Up Results from AUGMENT-HF: A Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial of Left Ventricular Augmentation with Algisyl-LVR in Heart Failure Treatment. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 11, 2015, at 10:45 AM. 1:00 PM: Dr. Valentin Fuster will discuss The Impact of a Comprehensive Lifestyle Peer-Group-Based Intervention on Cardiovascular Risk Factors: A Randomized Controlled Trial. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 9, 2015, at 11:04 AM. 1:30 PM: Drs. Justin Ezekowitz and Robert Welsh will present Providing Rapid Out-of-Hospital Acute Cardiovascular Treatment (PROACT-4). The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 10:45 AM. 2:00 PM: Dr. Mark Eisenberg will discuss The Efficacy and Safety of Varenicline for Smoking Cessation in Patients Hospitalized with Acute Coronary Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial. The embargo lifts on Monday, November 9, 2015, at 10:55 AM. 2:30 PM: Dr. Lars Wallentin will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up from a Scandinavian perspective. Tuesday, November 10, 2015 10:00 AM: Dr. Paul Whelton will present The Systolic Blood Pressure Intervention Trial (SPRINT). The embargo lifts on Monday, November 9, 2015, at 2:05 PM. 1:00 PM: Dr. Marc Bonaca will discuss Long-Term Tolerability of Ticagrelor in the PEGASUS-TIMI 54 Trial. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 11:15 AM. 1:30 PM: Dr. Freek Verheugt will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up from the Netherlands' perspective. 2:00 PM: Dr. Renato Lopes will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up in Portuguese. 2:30 PM: Dr. Myeong-Ki Hong will present Clinical Outcomes of Intravascular Ultrasound-Guided Everolimus-Eluting Stents Implantation in Long Coronary Lesions. The embargo lifts on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 11:00 AM. 3:00 PM: Dr. Kenneth Margulies will discuss A Randomized Trial of Liraglutide for High-Risk Heart Failure Patients with Reduced Ejection Fraction. The embargo lifts on Sunday, November 8, 2015, at 3:55 PM. 4:30 PM: Dr. Kevin Fitzgerald will present ALN-PCSsc, an RNAi Agent That Inhibits PCSK9 with Potential for Quarterly or Bi-Annual Dosing: Results of Phase 1 Trials in Adults with Elevated LDL-C. The embargo lifts on Wednesday, November 11, 2015, at 11:57 AM. 4:45 PM: Prof. Dr. Sigmund Silber will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up in German. Wednesday, November 11, 2015 9:30 AM: Prof. Harvey White will provide an AHA 2015 wrap-up from a Pacific Rim perspective.
